text:
sam: Hey — need an ad-hoc audit export to investigate a user-reported incident. Can someone confirm what's included by default (fields) and the approval process?

anya: What's the scope? time range and customers? We should avoid exporting raw request bodies/inputs.

sam: 2026-04-15 10:00->12:00 UTC, single customer org 'acme-corp', suspected API key misuse. Need: who did what (actor, action, resource), timestamps, request_id, src ip, user agent. Not the request payload.

mike: infra note: export tool generates ndjson.gz by default, columns: ts,actor,action,resource,request_id,ip,user_agent,meta. Payload fields are excluded unless you request full_payload=true (needs sec+legal).

anya: Also: by default IP and user emails are masked to last octet and domain redacted. If you need raw IPs/email we need privacy approval + temporary KMS-backed S3 bucket.

tess: legal/privacy: we'll need justification + retention plan. For an incident triage access for 8 hours is usually acceptable. No long-term copies without a DPA/Legal OK. Please open a ticket to privacy@ with the case id.

sam: Copy. I'll open a ticket. Question: what format do you prefer for downstream analysis — BigQuery load or local ndjson?

mike: BigQuery load is easiest for joins. We can push to a project dataset for you with a temp grant. Otherwise S3 ndjson.gz works.

anya: If you take BigQuery route, we can turn on column-level redaction in the pipeline and audit the access grant. Provide the case id and I'll approve scoping.

audit-bot: Audit export request created: EX-2026-431. See https://redwood/ops/exports/EX-2026-431 for status. Requester: sam. Approvers needed: anya (sec), tess (privacy), mike (infra)

sam: Thanks — filing ticket now and will include the curl example to generate the export.

sam: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/exports \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -d '{"org":"acme-corp","from":"2026-04-15T10:00:00Z","to":"2026-04-15T12:00:00Z","fields":["ts","actor","action","resource","request_id","ip","user_agent"],"redact":true,"deliver":"bq"}'
```

anya: Ping me in the ticket when done. I'll do a quick review of exported samples before grant.

tess: Once you have the export, don't attach to emails. Use secure links and set TTL.

sam: Got it, will follow up in thread EX-2026-431. :white_check_mark:
